review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Verified 128³ random log (BKM 1.243721, 22.9 steps/s) and 64³ TG CSV (BKM 1.634)
Checked 256³ random/Kerr ν sweeps against logs (incl. Kerr BKM≈9.99 vs random≈1.76)
Reviewed vortex-stretching / dealias implementation in ns3d_bkm.cu

overall_assessment: The best-documented CFD infrastructure finding: many CSV/log pairs agree to the reported digits, Kerr vs random contrast is real, and OOM limits are honest. This is certifying machinery toward a blowup search, not singularity evidence — and the page says so.
recommendations: Keep "infrastructure / no blowup evidence" hedges in every abstract
Document dt changes across the ν=1e-5 Kerr run
certification_justification: Standard 3D pseudospectral methods with unusually complete local artifacts for an early infrastructure paper.
